fact: Product: LumaTrail Everyday Bottle. Capacity: 600 ml. Price: €24.
The bottle body contains 60% recycled stainless steel by weight. No claim is approved for the whole product's recycled percentage.
Keeps drinks cold for up to 12 hours under laboratory test conditions. No hot-drink performance claim is supplied.
Leak-resistant when the lid is correctly closed. Do not describe it as leak-proof.
The bottle body is dishwasher-safe; hand-wash the lid. Colours: teal and sand. Live stock levels are not supplied.
Delivery charge: €4 per order. Estimated delivery: 3–5 business days. No discount or free-delivery offer is approved.
